scope: Offline next-step diagnostic draft only. No deployment, compilation, NPU run, timing or new qualification. Environment solely prepares EP2 serial; do not duplicate it.

identity.schedule: serial and overlap have distinct execution identity; neither P1 nor the other schedule qualifies overlap

key_findings.finding: Actual overlap order is cached dY dispatch -> dp/dZ -> dA -> dGU -> dXe -> async combine submission -> all experts dW1 -> all experts dW2 -> final event wait/release. No explicit pre-dW wait exists in overlap. dW1 and dW2 themselves remain ordered on the compute stream. Serial inserts the same completion event wait before dW1, preserving identical arithmetic and launch order.

Combine constructs producer event, communication stream waits producer, native combine then completion EventOverlap. Pre-native _collective_check is local unless runtime.debug_collectives enabled, when it performs HCCL all_gather+cpu readback. Host preflight/getter/drain delays may postpone dW host submission but are not by themselves proof of device serialization; actual debug mode and CPU/native task timing must be recorded.

Current native combine enqueues barrier/prepare/combine/barrier/dX copy and router-gradient copy; no host stream synchronize visible in this path. CATLASS DeviceGemm enqueues on supplied stream. This supports a logically asynchronous opportunity, not measured concurrent execution or speedup.

Event retains dx_e/dp_e/output/route tensors, records producer and consumer stream allocator use, and release follows queued final wait. Saved Xe/GU/A/Z/weights remain in ctx during both dW launches. dW1 reads dGU/Xe and dW2 reads dZ/A, while combine reads separate dXe/dp_e; no intended write-after-read conflict. Wait is queued even on either dW launch failure; it is not a host completion claim.

dp uses unweighted already-rounded BF16 Z: sum(de.float()*Z.float()); no division by p, valid at p=0. Gate/activation/GEMM BF16 boundaries and FP32 dW are unchanged. Return/casts occur after queued completion wait.

Small H=I=128 dW1[256,128] has2 tiles and dW2[128,128]1 tile per nonempty expert. Target dW1[4096,6144]768 tiles, dW2[6144,2048]384 tiles; both reach32AIC cap. Therefore EP2 small cannot establish main-shape resource competition/concurrency. Empty-expert weight_grad uses existing K=0 zero path, not a nonempty GEMM.

CATLASS empty AIV specialization does not establish physical scheduler/resource availability for concurrent combine. P1->P2 serial changes dW order and return placement; only same-order P2 serial->P2 overlap isolates early event wait. Do not assign reordering gains to overlap.

physical_overlap_followup_NOT_authorized.harness_gap: Existing P2 validator has no profiler/timing mode. A separately reviewed small profile-only outer harness is required; no adapter math edits or dispatch-host-trace hook transplantation. Do not turn precision step into timing or invent CLI flags.

For main claims, separately qualify exact EP16 B8192 H6144 I2048 E64 K8 balanced and compare that same target; EP2 cannot substitute. Main receives65536 rows/rank,16384/expert.

External alignment barrier is excluded from training scope. Two or three matched steps sufficient for a first timeline; no performance assertion from instrumented traces.

Producer-event record/comm wait, completion event record/compute wait flows if profiler exports them; absence is missing evidence, not fabricated event timing

criteria.logical_only: Two stream IDs, async=True, native_return, event existence, source order, host submissions or host-queue drain alone do not prove physical overlap.
criteria.physical: On one rank/device hardware clock, intersect union(dW1+dW2 hardware execution intervals) with backward-return transport kernel intervals. Positive resolved intersection supports physical concurrency on that device; report separately intersections with prepare/barrier/copy and label all scope. Do not mix CPU/derived tracks or forward/backward events.
criteria.not_speedup: Hardware concurrency alone may increase per-kernel duration through resource contention. Compare same-order serial/overlap target full-step per-rank/maxrank separately; no unsupported MFU/bandwidth estimate or P1 reorder attribution.

physical_overlap_followup_NOT_authorized.first_failure_stop: Identity/event/gradient/cleanup/foreign/resource/profiler failure => retain first error and existing artifacts; no automatic successor, replay or resource/backend change.
